original_test_intent: Run an approved MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline benchmark on the exact SUT configuration, obtain a valid result, and compare the appropriate metric with a genuinely comparable MLCommons reference.
original_method: Pin SUT/GPU/CPU/memory/storage topology, BIOS/power/thermal policy, OS/kernel, driver/CUDA/container, MLPerf inference harness revision/config, RetinaNet model/weights/dataset/calibration and checksums; isolate workloads; validate compliance/performance mode; run the exact approved Offline command once while monitoring health; preserve full logs, validity markers, throughput/latency and compare only to a matching reference/configuration with declared tolerance.
manual_activity: Owner supplies licensed/pinned benchmark package, comparable reference and run authorization; agent may validate and execute the approved harness with monitoring.
required_inputs: Exact MLPerf Inference v5.0 implementation/harness revision and configuration
RetinaNet model, weights, dataset/calibration assets, checksums and licenses
SUT software/hardware/power/thermal settings and exact run command
Comparable MLCommons system/result, metric, run mode, validity rules and acceptance tolerance
safety_requirements: Isolate workloads and verify cooling/power/storage capacity
Monitor GPU temperature/power/errors/throttling and host health with hard aborts
Run only verified local assets/command and preserve full output
Do not auto-retry failed/invalid/stressed runs or download/execute moving branches
agent_execution_scope: Run one approved benchmark and monitor/abort on thresholds
Parse validity, Offline samples-per-second/latency and compare approved reference
Do not choose assets/reference/tolerance, conceal invalidity, retry or decide DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve RetinaNet/BERT and training/inference source errors
Approve comparable reference, metric/tolerance and health aborts
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: An owner-provided command can execute the workload but does not establish that the source's `training_results_v5.0` is the correct inference harness or that the result is valid/comparable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned approved MLPerf Inference RetinaNet Offline config with full compliance/performance logs and synchronized health telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: RetinaNet, Offline scenario, v5.0 comparison and `make run` concept remain; BERT/training text is recorded as conflict.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a reproducible manifest and validity-aware parser, then compare only like-for-like system/division/category/scenario results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Pins all assets/configuration, resolves mode identity and adds health/validity/reference controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A command that exits zero or produces a number may still be an invalid audit/compliance run or incomparable to the selected MLCommons result.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Performance depends strongly on implementation, power/clock policy, dataset and accelerator count; 'not too far' has no meaning without an approved ratio/tolerance.

project_override_considerations: If the intended repository is a vendor submission tree rather than `training_results_v5.0`, record its exact source/revision. Do not replace RetinaNet with BERT under this row.
expected_evidence: Exact command, full build/run/compliance/performance logs and validity markers
Synchronized GPU/host health and abort status
Matched reference, metric/tolerance calculation and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row is titled and commanded as MLPerf Inference RetinaNet Offline, but instructs downloading `training_results_v5.0` and states 'The Bert performance should get valid results.' These identify different benchmark domains/models and cannot all be authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended RetinaNet Offline benchmark is identifiable; missing package/reference inputs and source conflict are recorded while static review completes.

review_improvement: Preserves RetinaNet Offline coverage while exposing copied benchmark identities and making reproducibility, validity and comparison engineering-grade.
independent_technical_reasoning: MLPerf training and inference repositories, BERT and RetinaNet, and Offline versus other scenarios use different assets, harnesses and metrics. A numeric result is only comparable when implementation, accelerator count, configuration, run mode and validity rules match. The workload can also saturate GPU power/thermal limits and produce throttled or error-contaminated scores. Therefore package identity, full logs, health telemetry and an approved like-for-like reference/tolerance are mandatory before execution or verdict.
